title: Forward the paired Undertow root to native VIXEN builds
body: VIXEN CMake now consumes the Undertow-generated text shader interface, but the shared Windows native runner had no Undertow root input. This lane had to translate and forward UNDERTOW_ROOT through native-build.sh and native-build.bat. Add an explicit paired interface-root input to the runner and include it in the build-ready identity so captures cannot reuse a build from another schema tree.

title: Run the no-new-mutex gate in native Windows builds
body: The native Windows configure printed 'no-new-mutex gate skipped: bash/python3 not found', so I had to invoke bash VIXEN/scripts/check-no-new-mutex.sh from WSL through the light queue to get a result (PASS with three existing unclassified rows). Provide a native-compatible gate invocation or run the WSL checker as part of the shared native build setup.
